jobs.title: Sr Manager, Finance Business Partner (Commercial)
jobs.description:
The Mosaic Company (NYSE: MOS) is the world’s leading integrated producer of concentrated phosphate and potash—two of the three most important nutrients in agriculture. We employ more than 13,000 people in six countries to serve farmers all over the world. Our Headquarters is in Lithia, Florida with operations throughout North America (U.S./Canada) and South America.

At Mosaic We Help the World Grow the Food it Needs - Apply today and join our team!

The Senior Manager – Finance Business Partner (Commercial NA) will lead financial support for the Commercial business and Org, including overseeing China and India. This role will provide strategic financial insights, performance analysis, and decision support to drive growth, profitability, and operational excellence. The position will manage planning, forecasting, and reporting processes, and collaborate closely with regional and global stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, and Biosciences.

What you’ll do?
- Lead financial business partnering for the global Commercial team, including North America. Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to support strategic and operational decisions. Manage budgeting, forecasting, and performance tracking processes. Collaborate with Corporate FP&A to ensure accuracy and alignment of financial data. Support margin analysis, pricing strategies, Working capital optimization and Capital Investments.

- Act as a strategic advisor to business unit leadership. Participate in strategy development and execution. Provide financial modeling and scenario analysis to support initiatives, investments, and commercial strategies. Ensure alignment with Mosaic’s financial goals and compliance with internal policies.

- Lead and develop finance team members. Provide coaching, feedback, and career development support. Foster a collaborative and high-performance culture across finance and commercial teams.

What you’ll need:
- A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or related field.

- MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred

- 8+ years in finance or business, with strong experience in business partnering and performance management

- Experience in agribusiness or industrial sectors preferred

- SAP, Hyperion, Power BI preferred

- Strategic thinking, financial modeling, cost management, KPI tracking, leadership

- Solid proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook and Excel.

What's in it for you:
- A competitive base salary + bonus incentives

- 11 paid holidays each year

- A generous 401k with a company match and annual company contribution

- Paid sick leave

- Paid vacation time

- A robust benefits package which includes Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, life & disability

- Tuition reimbursement

- Paid Paternity/Maternity Leave
